positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for client access by third party and internal users using Dropwizard framework in Java8 and Scala
- Developed transactional services, DAOs, and model objects around PostgreSQL databases
- Designed a backend system to help the conversion teams design and manage lead forms for conversion optimization
- Designed a backend system to manage pricing data across multiple in-house providers based on service and location

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed key marketing system solutions using Python and MySQL Database and Linux as backend
- Developed real time sync calls using a variety of APIs using Python
- Created and optimized databases for marketing data research and analysis
- Provided database support to ensure data integrity and monitor database activity

positions.title: QA Engineer (I)
positions.description:
- Pushed live updates on a consistent basis using Microsoft SQL Server
- Researched and debugged C# code using Microsoft Visual Studio 2010
- Reproduced and tested system errors reported by customers using Web Developer (i.e Firebug)
- Documented reproduction steps and resolution
- Coordinated and facilitated communication between developers and customer operations
